The events planned for the selected day are shown in the lower half
Press the button that is at the bottom right with a plus symbol, enter the details in the floating dialog and press Save to add a new event to the selected date

When you tap an event, the Save or Delete button will appear in the event editor. Tap Delete to remove the event. Alternatively, tap and hold the event you want to delete and then tap "Delete" in the pop-up window.
To add a new task press the Create button, enter all the details and press Save
To delete a task press on the task you want to delete and press the Delete button
To edit a task press on the task you want to modify, change any detail you want and press Save
Enable or disable features you want to see in the main menu
Already have an account? Log In
To upload a document, click the "Create" button in the bottom right corner. Once you have selected the document, a dialog box will appear where you can name it.
To download the document, click on the document you want to download. This will open a window where you can view and download the file.
To create a comment, you have to press the create button, enter the tittle, the username, and the comment.
To edit, you have to click on a post and you will be able to edit the tittle, the name and the comment
" To delete, you have to click on a post and you will see a button to delete it."
Pressing the invite button on the home screen will display a menu with several applications through which to share the application link.
To create a contact, you have to press the create button and enter the requested information.
To edit, you have to tap on the contact, modify the data you want, and tap save.
To delete, you have to tap on the contact, modify the data you want, and tap delete.
To configure the theme, you have to tap on Theme and choose your preferred mode: dark mode, light mode, or automatic.
To enable or disable a feature, press the corresponding switch. Doing so will show or hide it in the main menu.
To add information to your profile, tap the button in the upper right corner, enter the requested information, and select Save.
To take photos, you must first grant the necessary camera permissions. Once activated, press the circular button in the center of the screen to capture the image.
To access your gallery, tap the circular preview image. This will display all the photos stored in your device.

Settings panel where you can choose the application theme (automatic) and select which tools you want to see in your main menu.
It allows you to take photographs and access the image gallery using a preview button located next to the shutter release.
It allows you to easily view, search, add, and edit your contact information from a centralized list.
Interactive wall to publish, edit and share messages in real time with the rest of the team.
Interactive wall for sharing messages with the team. Allows you to post text, edit it, and view attached images in full screen with just a tap.
Organize your to-dos with statuses (Done, In Progress, Pending). Tap the colored buttons at the top to instantly filter the list and see only the tasks with that status.
Organize your daily events clearly. Add new appointments with details (attendees, time, and description) and quickly view your entire schedule.
